overview:
California's 26th District, anchored in Ventura County, leans Democratic by nine points, and retirement of incumbent Julia Brownley has handed the seat to an open contest. State Assemblymember Jacqui Irwin enters as the Democratic nominee with roughly $295,000 on hand after raising more than $820,000, and outside groups have added over $360,000 of support on her side.

Republican Sam Gallucci has raised about $489,000 but reports under $30,000 in cash and no recorded outside backing, leaving him a significant resource gap heading into the fall. No public polls cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals, candidate finances, and prediction markets, all of which favor Democrats decisively. The seat remains solidly in the Democratic column, though the absence of polling leaves the precise margin less certain than the overall verdict.
